args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's review (sources: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, Moss's Coastal digests/cheat sheet; plus your own Pellucid cutover note, which is public).

Pellucid Harbor Logistics (PHL)
- #4419: Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. Open. (Moss cheat sheet)
- PD-8841: how Pemberline Dock handles chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, Gate 4B. (your 2025-12-08 note)
- No ticket number: CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map (your 2025-12-08 note, then described as lingering).
- Not a ticket, but the cheat sheet lists chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change as the main friction point.

Driftmoor Marine Freight (DMF)
- Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers. (Moss cheat sheet)
- #4419: barge slip 7 schedule sync, with a request for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. (Moss digest 2025-11-02)
- No ticket number: Tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B; engineering gave a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher. (Moss cheat sheet)

Heads-up: #4419 is attached to two different issues on two accounts (PHL Yard_Dwell_Summary in the cheat sheet, DMF slip 7 sync in the Nov digest). One is probably a wrong number, so check it in the ticket system before the review.

Left out: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark items (#8812, PD-4821) and the Saltmarsh tickets. I found no feature requests for PHL. I can only see what's in these channels and notes, and nothing is dated after Nov 2025 for either account, so I can't tell you what's still open.
